heading: Learn in a Real Working Salon
blockquote: Train in the environment where professional dog grooming happens every day.
body:
Our spacious training salon in Congresbury gives students hands-on experience with a wide variety of breeds, coat types, sizes and temperaments. Rather than learning through theory alone, you will practise the techniques, routines and professional standards used in a working grooming business.

You will be supported by qualified, experienced tutors who understand that every student learns differently. Whether you are starting from the beginning or returning to develop existing skills, we create a friendly and encouraging environment in which you can ask questions, practise safely and grow in confidence.
